summary: LangChain's ready-to-run agent harness that plans, works with files and manages its own context for long, multi-step tasks.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Deep Agents is an open-source agent harness from LangChain: an opinionated agent that runs out of the box, with defaults tuned for long-horizon, multi-step work. It can plan, read and write files and manage its own context, and you can extend, override or replace any piece.
sixtySeconds.problem: Building an agent that handles long tasks well takes a lot of plumbing. Deep Agents gives you a working harness to start from.
whoFor: Teams prototyping research or coding agents
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a batteries-included starting point with sub-agents, custom tools and swappable models, without forking.
requirements: An API key for your model provider

overview: Add the package with uv add deepagents, then call create_deep_agent with a model string and a system prompt, and invoke it with messages.
Out of the box the agent can plan, read and write files and manage context. You can add tools, swap models, customise prompts and configure sub-agents.
LangSmith is suggested for debugging and deploying. Deep Agents is MIT licensed.

install.verificationNote: Commands come from Deep Agents's README. AIRepoHub hasn't run them yet.

firstRun.title: Create and run an agent
firstRun.code:
from deepagents import create_deep_agent

agent = create_deep_agent(
    model="openai:gpt-6-astra",
    system_prompt="You are a research assistant.",
)
result = agent.invoke({"messages": "Research LangGraph and write a summary"})
